historical_findings.summary: Managed catalog/index divergence breaks the research Spawn Packet.
Standalone catalog reinstall deletes current logical-owned data-db and integrations-ops profiles.
The index writer follows an escaping symlink.
Rollback receipts depend on future topology and fail after drift.

findings.summary: Rollback previously overwrote or deleted pre-existing post-sync target drift.
Stale logical ownership across catalog evolution was previously lost during catalog reinstall.
Shape plus mtime previously laundered backdated tampered content into logical ownership.
Installed runtime configs previously retained mode 0664.
Cooperative TOCTOU previously remained between preflight or classification and mutation.
Inherited FD inode identity previously failed to prove held flock ownership.
Rollback previously materially validated the receipt before acquiring the shared lock.
Combined sync previously left standalone catalog and logical ownership receipts stale or absent.
Third-OFD contention was previously mistaken for inherited-FD ownership across all four mutators.
A supported standalone logical reinstall after sync previously rewrote only the logical receipt, changed installed_digest, and invalidated schema-4 rollback.
The logical fast path previously accepted state outside CODEX_HOME rollback and backup history.
A directory at the receipt path plus real drift previously caused partial profile mutation before final receipt replacement failed; RED was review-observed and GREEN regression passed at root.
Logical fast path previously accepted a receipt-updated renamed backup within CODEX_HOME backups and mode 0666, unlike catalog exact target-to-backup validation.
Catalog receipt late publication failure previously left temporary and backup artifacts and restored target mode drift.
Catalog no-op previously accepted a hardlinked receipt with nlink 2.
Catalog previously accepted a logical receipt rollback_directory different from the actual backup parent while logical rejected it.
Governing dashboard, traceability and task ledger were stale or contradictory after G10.
External post-G10-sync drift changed root reasoning effort to low while topology requires medium; governed G11 resync restored Sol medium and mirror plus fresh root plus seven passed.
